created_by: Offline processing of downloaded generated audio; no remote generation by this tool
processing: Average channels to mono; preserve 48000 Hz sources (polyphase resample other source rates to 48000 Hz); first-order zero-phase Butterworth highpass at 60 Hz to remove DC and low rumble, with no added lowpass; 2 ms sine-squared attack fade and 40 ms sine-squared tail fade; target -21 dBFS full-clip RMS with -3 dBFS peak ceiling; signed PCM16 WAV. No pitch shift, time stretch, trimming, or dynamic compression.
auditory_qa: Not performed by this processor; objective signal checks only. Variants are not ranked by listening.
